mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_invoice_statistics (stat_id, stat_month, issue_count, total_amount, total_tax, verify_count, verify_pass_count, reimburse_count, reimburse_approve_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{statId}, #{statMonth}, #{issueCount}, #{totalAmount}, #{totalTax}, #{verifyCount}, #{verifyPassCount}, #{reimburseCount}, #{reimburseApproveCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_invoice_statistics SET issue_count = #{issueCount}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, total_tax = #{totalTax}, verify_count = #{verifyCount}, verify_pass_count = #{verifyPassCount}, reimburse_count = #{reimburseCount}, reimburse_approve_count = #{reimburseApproveCount}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE stat_id = #{statId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_invoice_statistics WHERE stat_month >= #{startMonth} AND stat_month <= #{endMonth} ORDER BY stat_month
mapper.update: UPDATE t_invoice_statistics SET issue_count = issue_count + 1, total_amount = total_amount + #{amount}, total_tax = total_tax + #{tax}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE stat_month = #{statMonth}

UPDATE t_invoice_statistics SET verify_count = verify_count + 1, verify_pass_count = verify_pass_count + CASE WHEN #{passed} = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE stat_month = #{statMonth}

UPDATE t_invoice_statistics SET reimburse_count = reimburse_count + CASE WHEN #{approved} = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, reimburse_approve_count = reimburse_approve_count + CASE WHEN #{approved} = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE stat_month = #{statMonth}
